  - paragraph: Regulation (EU) 2024/1157 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 April 2024 on shipments of waste, which amends Regulations (EU) No 1257/2013 and (EU) 2020/1056 and repeals Regulation (EC) No 1013/2006, and is the primary EU instrument governing transboundary movement of waste intra-EU, on export, on import, and in transit, referencing the Basel Convention of 22 March 1989 and the related OECD Council Decision on transboundary waste movements. It applies within the European Union.
